items.title: EagleRock, Texas Pacific Land stocks rise on $3B deal
items.summary: Investing.com -- Texas Pacific Land Corp (NYSE:TPL) shares gained 3.5% in premarket trading Monday, while EagleRock Land LLC (NYSE:EROK) jumped 12.7% after the companies announced an all-stock merger valued at approximately $3.0 billion.
